capabilities: Plan events and scheduled tasks on a daily timeline
Manage tasks on a Kanban board with subtasks and carryovers
Track work sessions with start, pause, resume, and finish controls
Organize tasks and events into projects with goals
Embed the dashboard in notes via a code block
extras: Manual installation only; community plugin listing is being prepared. Requires Obsidian 1.8.7+. The README warns to keep a backup before starting since the plugin edits vault notes. Google Calendar sync and dragging existing events to reschedule are not supported.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in view that shows a day's events, scheduled tasks, and actual tracked work together on one dashboard.
summary: Daily dashboard plugin that combines a timeline of events, a Kanban task board, projects, and work-session tracking, storing everything as Markdown notes.
